# Shift handover: personal-assistant chats (books, podcasts, bags, meals, writing jobs) · 2026-11-11 22:22
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. No repo files matter here: this was a general chat session with no code work. Read this file fully, then read it back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given (`/shift-change quick`)

## 0 · Read these first
Nothing in the repo. The repo has one commit (`b330c16 start`) and nothing but `.claude/` and `.gitignore`. All deliverables (resume, cover letter, burnout book material, GoodSpace posts) were written **only in chat**. None was saved to disk.

## 1 · Status
🟢 No open task is mid-flight. The last exchange (2023-05-30 05:50) was answered. Several earlier threads ended unfinished or with the user unhappy (see §3). Many specifics the agent gave were **probably invented** (see §6). Do not repeat them as fact.

## 2 · Picture
The session is a series of dated chat sessions, 2023-05-20 → 2023-05-30, all from one user, on unrelated everyday topics: book recommendations, an ASCII heart, website engagement ideas, podcasts (true crime, news, entrepreneurship, productivity), continuing a burnout book package, organizing a commute bag and buying a new work bag, GoodSpace social posts, a cover letter and resume for "Jin Yu", and quick low-carb dinners. The next session will most likely get questions that build on what the user said about themselves, with dates. §5 is the most important section.

## 3 · Open threads / likely next actions
1. **Website engagement (05-23)**: unresolved. The user rejected every list as "not good enough". The website type and audience were never asked. If it comes up again, ask what the site is first, then give ONE concrete, specific idea. Don't send another generic list. · done when the user accepts an idea.
2. **ASCII heart (05-21)**: failed 4 times. If asked again, give a heart you have checked line by line, e.g.
   ` ** ** ` / `*******` / ` ***** ` / `  ***  ` / `   *   ` in a code block. Never call it "subjective".
3. **GoodSpace posts (05-29)**: the table stopped mid-row at post #15 ("…make recruitment more efficient and cost"). Finish from #15 if asked. The agent framed it oddly as "Merchynt's Magical Social Media Posts" with a merchynt.com plug. The user never asked for that, so drop it.
4. **Burnout book package (05-26 15:11)**: the user said "Continue writing please" twice. Items done: #5 titles 47–50, #6 press release, #7 blog post (**cut off mid-sentence** at "Seek Social Support… as well as"), #8 Chapter Two manuscript. The blog post (#7) is still unfinished. Items 1–4 of the package came before this session and were never seen. Book: "Beyond Burnout: A Roadmap to Resilience and Well-being", 4 chapters (Understanding / Recognizing / Preventing / Recovering).
5. **Dinner (05-30)**: the user planned to cook the one-pot chicken/cherry-tomato/spinach pasta "for dinner tonight" (2023-05-30), with frozen spinach and leftover chicken. A follow-up on how it turned out is plausible.
6. **Sweatshirt**: the user meant to ask their mom to send their favourite sweatshirt (§5).

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Analytics tools / page-speed tech tips for the website | User: "I don't have the time or patience to use any of these analytical tools", "I don't care about any of these technical details" | the user asks for technical help |
| Generic idea lists (VR/AR/AI/gamification/contests/viral challenge) | rejected 4 times as "not good enough" | never resend them |
| Calling the failed ASCII hearts "subjective" | User: "It is not a matter of subjective opinion. There was no recognizable heart shape anywhere" | never |
| Citing specific episode numbers, product model names, or "The Power by Octavia Butler" | likely made up (§6) | only after checking them |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** (dates are 2023; [user said] unless noted):
- **Reading**: recently finished *The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo* and loved it. Joined an online book club discussion of it on **Facebook Live, Feb 22**, where the author (Taylor Jenkins Reid) answered their question. Has meant to read *The Royal We* and "might give that a try".
- Heard **Emily St. John Mandel** read from *Sea of Tranquility* at their **local library** (before May 20). Asked her about the inspiration for **Olive Llewellyn** (her answer drew on her own experience as a writer and observer of human nature). Bought a **signed copy**.
- Went to a **literary festival on March 4**: Celeste Ng, Tommy Orange and Ayobami Adebayo on diversity in contemporary literature. Highlight: Ng deliberately writes diverse characters and storylines to reflect the real world.
- **Work book club** read *The Power* (Naomi Alderman) "last month" (said May 20 → ~April 2023). The user loved it. Discussion leader: **Rachel**.
- **Podcasts**: into true crime and inspiring stories. As of May 26, had just finished **episode 12 of "My Favorite Murder"** and aims for at least one episode a week. Listens to **The Daily**. Uses **Spotify and Apple Podcasts** and plays at **1.5x on Apple Podcasts**. Wants custom playlists and speed control. Planned to try "Criminal".
- As of May 29: loves **"How I Built This"**, **~15 episodes finished**. **Commute ~45 min each way**, spent on podcasts and books. Interested in the early days of Airbnb/LinkedIn and in **non-technical founders**. **Cutting down on social media** for mental health, which feels more productive. Wants personal-development and productivity content.
- **Bags (May 27)**: uses a **black leather backpack** for the daily work commute, getting worn out. Took a **duffel bag on a weekend trip to visit family "two weeks ago"** (said May 27 → ~May 13). Left their **favourite sweatshirt at their mom's** and needs to ask her to send it. Forgets the **lunchbox and gym clothes** and plans to make a **packing checklist**. Wants a new work bag: **tote or backpack**, room for **laptop + water bottle**, **multiple compartments**, **leather or durable nylon**. No colour preference given yet.
- **Food (May 30)**: had been relying on takeout. For **the past two weeks** (said May 30 → since ~May 16) has eaten **oats with fruits and nuts** for breakfast instead of the usual **toast with scrambled eggs**. Mentioned this twice, so it matters to them. **Trying to cut carbs.** Had **leftover chicken breast** in the fridge.
- **Work-ish asks**: wrote for **GoodSpace** (AI recruitment platform: employers post jobs and view responses for free, and pay only to contact shortlisted candidates). Needed a cover letter and resume for **Jin Yu** (21, Korean woman, ~3 years at Starbucks, 2nd-year Journalism at Toronto Metropolitan University, Niagara Falls ON). Whether Jin Yu is the user or someone they are helping is unknown [assumed]. The contact details are in the user's 05-30 message. Don't repeat them unless asked.

| I assumed | User corrected | Rule from now on | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unchecked ASCII art would pass | 4 rejections | Check the shape before sending; own the failure, don't blame subjectivity | "It is not a matter of subjective opinion" |
| Tool lists and how-tos help | wanted zero effort, no tech | Lead with one concrete action, skip the tool/tech detail | "just tell me one simple thing" |
| Volume of ideas = value | wanted novelty | Fewer, sharper, specific ideas; ask about the site first | "None of those suggestions seem good enough" |

## 6 · Evidence ledger (what the agent said that is unreliable)
| Claim the agent made | Status |
|---|---|
| "The Power by Octavia Butler" | **false**: no such book |
| *Song of Achilles* "from Patroclus' perspective as Achilles' lover"; *Sea of Tranquility* described as "post-apocalyptic" | loose or wrong |
| Exact episode numbers for Masters of Scale / Foundr / Mixergy / Startup seasons (e.g. "Startup Season 1: The Instagram Story") | **likely invented**, unchecked |
| Founder bios (Apoorva Mehta "not technical", Melanie Perkins "designer", Lefkofsky/Blumenthal "lawyer") | likely wrong |
| "5 AM Miracle Podcast" hosted by Hal Elrod | wrong (that's Jeff Sanders; Elrod hosts Achieve Your Goals) |
| Castbox/Pocket Casts/Anchor can build playlists "from Spotify" | wrong: they use public RSS; Spotify exclusives can't be imported; Anchor is a creation tool; Breaker and Stitcher are since defunct |
| Bag models: "Kate Spade Cameron Street Lacey", "Tumi T-Tech Carryall", "Madewell Transport Backpack" | partly invented (the Madewell Transport is a tote); North Face Borealis and Côte&Ciel Isar are real |
| Resume additions: Brock "Bachelor of Business Administration", cash handling/inventory, conflict resolution; cover letter "passion for mixology" | **invented**: the user never stated these; flag them if the resume is revisited |
| Low-carb tips: soy sauce "high in carbs", grass-fed beef "lower carb", "pound chicken to 1–1.5 in" | dubious (pound to ~¾ in) |
| Burnout ch.2: "Oldenburg inventory has nine dimensions"; MBI as a diagnosis | wrong (OLBI has 2 dimensions: exhaustion and disengagement; MBI isn't diagnostic) |

## 6b · What I told or made for the user
- **Books**: recommended The Royal We, Devil Wears Prada, The Interestings, The Address, Daisy Jones & The Six, The Last Romantics, The Age of Light. For power and resistance: Handmaid's Tale, (fake) Butler, The Fifth Season, The Poppy War, Song of Achilles.
- **Podcasts (05-26)**: true crime: Last Podcast on the Left, Crime Junkie, Small Town Dicks, Criminal (Phoebe Judge; thoughtful, more serious than MFM), The Vanished. Inspiring: How I Built This, Tim Ferriss, TED Radio Hour, School of Greatness, Happier. News like The Daily: Pod Save America, Ben Shapiro, Axe Files, Politico Playbook, NPR Politics, Stay Tuned with Preet (top picks: Pod Save America and NPR Politics). Apps: suggested **Castbox or Pocket Casts**.
- **05-29**: entrepreneurship list (Masters of Scale, Startup, Mixergy, Foundr, etc.), plus 10 productivity podcasts and 15 books (7 Habits, GTD, Essentialism, Deep Work, Pomodoro Technique, Mindset, 5 AM Club, Power of Now, Miracle Morning, Daring Greatly, 10X Rule, The One Thing, Crush It!, Art of Possibility, You Are a Badass…).
- **Bag**: a frequency-of-use tier system (high: laptop/phone/wallet/keys/water/snacks; medium, 2–3×/week: gym clothes, lunchbox; low; rarely used), a "maybe" pouch, and a checklist/reminder idea. Brands: Tumi, Kate Spade, Frye, Côte&Ciel, Madewell.
- **Dinner**: 10 quick meals. One-pot pasta recipe: 1 lb chicken, 1 Tbsp olive oil, onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 cup cherry tomatoes, 1 cup spinach, 1 cup whole-grain pasta, ¼ cup white wine, ¼ cup broth, cook to 165°F/74°C. Tomatoes: Sungold, grape, cherry Roma, heirloom. Frozen spinach is OK: thaw, squeeze dry, add near the end. Leftover chicken is OK: add near the end, a little extra broth, check it was stored at ≤40°F. Note: pasta conflicts with the user's low-carb goal, which was never raised with them.
- **Resume / cover letter for Jin Yu**: two resume versions (the second is "more formal and elaborate", with a Professional Summary).

## 9 · Gotchas
- Dates in this session are 2023 chat dates. Convert relative phrases using the session date shown (e.g. "two weeks ago" on 05-27 → ~05-13).
- On 05-27 the user's last message ("I'll make sure to consider your preferences…") looked like a role slip. The agent replied by clarifying that it has no preferences.

---
Handover fidelity: exam skipped (`quick`) · Known gaps: purpose of the website, Jin Yu's relation to the user, and the first four parts of the burnout package were never seen.
question: What is the total number of episodes I've listened to from 'How I Built This' and 'My Favorite Murder'?
answer:

- **How I Built This:** about 15 episodes, as you said on May 29.
- **My Favorite Murder:** 12 episodes. On May 26 you said you'd just finished episode 12, so I'm assuming you started from episode 1.
